records.text: Erika Kirk's social-media posts from 2011 praised Terry Crist and described friendship with Judith Crist and enthusiasm for City of Grace
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Now, Pastor Terry Crist is mentioned on her X feed as early as 2011. She says Pastor Terry (Terry Crist) is awesome. ... I cherish your friendship and I'm grateful for your love, Judith Crist. That would be his wife. ... I am totally obsessed with City of Grace

verification.notes: The transcript displays purported 2011 social posts praising Terry and Judith Crist and City of Grace. Current searches did not locate archived originals or authenticated captures sufficient to verify the posts independently.

records.text: Ashley said Terry Crist was a close friend of Hillsong founder Brian Houston and reported that Crist said his own resignation shortly after Houston's was unrelated
records.speaker: Ashley (Candace Owens producer; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: So he is very good friends with Brian Houston, who was the founder of Hillsong. ... Brian Houston resigned eventually, and then right afterward Pastor Terry Crist also resigned from his church, but he said it wasn't related, so nothing to see there.

verification.notes: Current and contemporaneous sources show Terry Crist did not resign from his own local church: he withdrew the Phoenix congregation from the global Hillsong organization while continuing to lead it. He explicitly cited Hillsong's governance crisis and loss of confidence after Brian Houston's resignation, contradicting the claim that the moves were unrelated.

sources.title: Hillsong Phoenix pastor announces separation from global church
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous report states Crist separated the local church from Hillsong and cited governance and loss of confidence after Houston's resignation.

records.text: Ashley relayed an unverified word-on-the-street allegation that Terry and Judith Crist had congregants vomit into bags to expel bad spirits
records.speaker: Ashley (Candace Owens producer; surname unverified)

appearances.snippet: and his wife were accused of having—well, this is just word on the street—but they would have their congregants throw up into bags to get rid of big, bad spirits. That's just word on the street, allegedly.

verification.notes: Transcript context directly records Ashley St. Clair relaying the bag-vomiting story while repeatedly labeling it unverified 'word on the street.' This verifies the narrow attribution and its caveat only; it does not substantiate the underlying allegation about Terry and Judith Crist.
